parsed.main_gap: A minor arithmetic typo occurs in the proof that the signed sum of powers of two is nonzero; correcting it immediately restores the argument.

errors.description: The geometric sum is miscalculated: 1+2+⋯+2^{k-1}=2^k−1, not 2^k−2. The needed strict inequality 2^k>2^k−1 still holds, so this is straightforwardly repairable.
errors.quote: the largest power $2^k$ is greater than the sum $1+2+\cdots+2^{k-1}=2^k-2$ of all smaller powers

parsed.notes: Apart from this typo, the game-value reduction, pairing lemma, graph lower bound, refinement construction, and subset-sum upper bound form a coherent and essentially complete proof of the stated answer.
